'''Florn''', known as '''Tinatorn''' while under the control of [[Xim's empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> was the [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproid]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was mostly dense [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] with a few large [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. The jungles of Florn were said to be so deadly that any sentient on Florn's surface without [[hyperaccelerated nerve implant]]s, or a similar level of natural reflexes, risked certain and sudden death.

The planet was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The galactic community became aware that the planet was the Lamproid homeworld at some point between the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Prior to that, the Lamproid homeworld had been a mystery, as the Lamproids had many colony worlds, and were often wrongly viewed as nonsentient. At some point, however, the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] had [[Raid on Florn|raided]] the planet prior to the arrival of the [[Exiles]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
